title: Can Claude replace Greenhouse? 29/29 checks, 18 spec gaps #shorts
description:
Claude built a Greenhouse alternative, a hiring pipeline with honest scorecards, from one written spec: all 29 acceptance checks passed, and the build exposed 18 gaps in the spec.

Full build test (2:42): https://youtu.be/rw6fRDPld90
The free spec: https://personalsoftwarefactory.com/blueprints/hiring-pipeline
Greenhouse pricing and alternatives: https://personalsoftwarefactory.com/alternatives/greenhouse

Made with AI: Sam's on-camera hook and outro are an AI avatar of him, and the narration is his AI voice clone (HeyGen). The product footage is from the real test build.
